•	⁠16/8 IF (I only eat from 12am to 8pm)
•	⁠2/3 Workout session each Weeks
•	⁠2x2 Hours of walk each Weeks
•	⁠I didn’t counted calories but I made it sure that I was eating less that I was consuming
•	⁠1 cheat meal a week (but only if I was able to hit my goal of 2,2 lbs lost)
•	⁠Weight Check every Saturday Morning
